label: Cyclops register study (chrome pole)
description: Generate cyclops-register candidates — factory-new single-optic antagonists. Perfectly symmetric, designed shutlines, unmarked chrome and carbon fibre, cold body neon, identical units.

style_prefix: anamorphic lens, shallow depth of field, fine film grain
low-key lighting with a strong shadow side, lit by the environment's own emitters
prompt_strategy._style_prefix_law: BOOTSTRAP PHASE ONLY — see outcast-study for the full law. The prompt carries the style until the LoRA exists; this vocabulary never enters a training caption, and production prompts drop it for the trigger once trained.
must_include: a specified lighting environment with something worth reflecting (LIT-002 — chrome is a mirror; neon signage above and wet ground below give it content)
cold body neon as status/branding, emitting onto adjacent surfaces (NEON-001, MAT-003)

negative_strategy._INERT_ON_FLUX2: Flux.2 IGNORES negative prompts entirely. Retained as CURATION criteria for the ai-eyes gate and human review, NOT as prompt text.
must_avoid: any wear, rust, scuffing, or repair (the register is factory-new)
weld scars or mismatched panels (SEAM-001 — outcast grammar)
individuating detail where multiple units appear (UNI-001 — uniformity IS the threat)
neon rendered as a flat decal with no spill (MAT-003)

drift_guards: chrome must reflect a real environment, never read as grey paint (MAT-001)
carbon weave scale consistent relative to panel size (MAT-002)
cold palette pole; arc colours only as emitted light, never as paint (PAL-001)
